title: Enterprise Data Architect
description:
**Responsibilities**
* Analyze the business requirements and needs of the organization.
* Architect and design robust, scalable, and secure enterprise data platform leveraging Databricks and various cloud services on Microsoft Azure.
* Lead implementation of advanced data analytics solutions utilizing Databricks and Delta Lake architectures to extract, transform, and load (ETL) data.
* Leverage Databricks to perform data engineering, artificial intelligence and machine learning tasks.
* Collect, process, and analyze large datasets from various sources within the aviation domain (e.g., flight data, baggage information, weather data, operational logs etc.).

* Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in data to provide valuable insights and support business decision\-making.
* Contribute to the development of data models and database designs.
* Document data sources, data flows, and analytical processes.
* Stay up to date with the latest trends and technologies in data analysis and the aviation industry.
* Create insightful and interactive data visualizations and reports using tools like Power BI to communicate findings to non\-technical audiences.
* Define and govern enterprise\-wide cloud architecture standards, security protocols, and operational best practices.
* Developing and implementing strategies to connect different systems, ensuring they can share data and functionality
* Defining and managing API that allow different software applications to communicate with each other
* Defining and managing asynchronous data exchange between applications and as a part of data pipelines
* Designing real\-time streaming pipelines for IoT time\-series data
* Diving deep into the details to solve complex technical challenges

* Ensuring high data quality and integrity to avoid operational failures and improve system accuracy
* Perform regular audits and maintenance of the platform to ensure its continued performance and stability.
* Support project management activities, resource monitoring, technical risk identification \& mitigations
* Mentor and provide technical leadership to platform engineering and data engineering teams.
* Ensure continuous platform optimization, cost management, and high availability of critical analytics infrastructure.
* Partner with business stakeholders to translate airport operational requirements into technical blueprints and scalable solutions.

 Required Qualifications \& Experience
   

  

* Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or equivalent advanced architectural certification.
* Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional or similar advanced credential in big data ecosystems.
* Proven track record of designing large\-scale digital platforms in complex operational environments, preferably within aviation or large infrastructure.


 Educational Background
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.
* Advanced certifications in Enterprise Architecture frameworks such as TOGAF are highly preferred.


 Years \& Type of Experience
   

  

* 15 to 20 years of progressive experience in IT, with at least 5\+ years in a senior architectural capacity.
* Demonstrated experience leading large\-scale data engineering and analytics transformation programs utilizing Microsoft Azure and Databricks.


 Domain Expertise
   

  

* Deep functional knowledge of cloud computing paradigms (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) and distributed data systems.
* Strong understanding of big data ecosystems, data warehousing, and modern data mesh architectures.
* Familiarity with the aviation or large\-scale infrastructure domain, including passenger processing, non\-aero revenue analytics, and airport operations.


 Digital \& Operational Tools
   

  

* Cloud Platforms: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Azure services (Azure Data Factory, Azure Event Hub, Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure IoT Hub etc).
* Data \& Analytics: Expertise in Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and enterprise Business Intelligence platforms.
* Proficiency in one programming languages such as JavaScript/Node.js, Java, Python, etc.
* Expertise in databases like PostgreSQL, MS SQL, and MongoDB.
* Expertise in APIs, ESB (Enterprise Service Bus), and Kafka.
* Integration with IoT platforms (Azure IoT Hub), device protocols (MQTT, AMQP, HTTP)
* Experience of data analytics, business intelligence, and AI/ML technologies
* Use of AI tools for code generation, pipeline automation, testing
* Knowledge of Azure DevOps, Docker, Kubernetes, and enterprise source control systems.
* Understanding of machine learning fundamentals (supervised, unsupervised, feature engineering)
* Experience supporting ML model lifecycle (training data, inference pipelines)
* Exposure to LLMs, GenAI pipelines, and vector databases
* Knowledge of feature engineering and model\-ready datasets
* Knowledge of MLOps tools (MLflow, Kubeflow, Airflow, etc.)
* Building CI/CD pipelines for data \+ ML workflows
* Experience of Agile methodologies, Jira, and Confluence.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity principles and practices.

* Ability to drive technical consensus and influence technology strategy across diverse stakeholder groups and executive leadership.
* Strategic thinker with a demonstrated capability to align IT and platform roadmaps with long\-term business objectives.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python+AI)
description:
You'll take over day\-to\-day backend ownership. The core of the job is building: new API servers and data models across our platform — some already in flight, more planned — on Python and Azure. You'll also maintain and extend our production multi\-agent system (Python/LangGraph fronting a healthcare data warehouse): it's largely built, and needs incremental improvement, monitoring, and steady hands.
 



 You'll carry the backend through a major go\-live this fall, working directly with the key engineering team and product owner. 
 



  





**What you'll do** 
  
 


* Design and build new API services and data models — greenfield development is the bulk of the role, picking up in\-flight work and starting planned services from scratch.
* Maintain and extend the production LangGraph multi\-agent backend: incremental capabilities, tool integrations, monitoring, and reliability.
* Design and build multi\-tenant access control: per\-organization data isolation, credential architecture, JWT/OIDC auth flows (Auth0\).
* Run the backend's Azure footprint day to day: managed identities, Key Vault, CI/CD pipelines, environment promotion (dev → UAT → prod).
* Handle healthcare data responsibly — PHI\-aware design is part of the job.
* Work async with a founder\-led team and an external dev shop; write decisions down.



  





**What we're looking for** 
  
 


* 4\+ years of backend engineering with deep, current Python.
* A track record of designing and shipping API services and data models from scratch — not just extending existing systems.
* You've worked with LLM agent systems in production — LangGraph preferred, or comparable frameworks with real users behind them.
* Production Azure experience: identity, secrets, app hosting, pipelines.
* Strong SQL (SQL Server and/or Postgres) and multi\-tenant data\-access design.
* Auth fundamentals: OAuth2/OIDC, JWT.
* Self\-directed — you'll often be the only engineer on the problem.
* Hands on experience with Azure is a Big Plus
* Bonus: US healthcare data (claims, CMS programs), HIPAA experience, Terraform.

description:

 We are looking for a hands\-on Software Engineering Manager to lead the Funded Development (Services / NRR) POD — the cross\-functional team accountable for delivering customer\-funded enhancements and bespoke solutions on top of our trading platform. The POD’s core surface is Order Routing and the Market Data ecosystem, with regular contributions into Risk, FIX services, trading UI enhancements and other backend systems as customer commitments require.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Delivery \& stakeholder ownership — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* Hands\-on technical leadership \& design — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability. Set the quality bar through architecture, design, and code reviews in modern C\+\+, and be the escalation\-of\-last\-resort on hard issues.
* Cross\-component versatility \& engineering excellence — Deliver across a broad surface — Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, and trading UI enhancements — as customer commitments evolve. Drive engineering best practices across the POD: modern C\+\+ standards, multithreading and concurrency correctness, performance tuning, automated testing, and CI hygiene. Treat customer\-funded work as first\-class product code, not throwaway one\-offs, and build a POD that can flex across components without becoming shallow on any of them.
* AI\-assisted engineering — Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, and internal AI tooling) across the POD to accelerate delivery, code review, test authoring, design exploration, and production diagnostics. Set the bar for responsible use — quality, security, IP protection, and human accountability for shipped code — and share patterns that work back into the wider engineering org.
* SE \+ SQE leadership — Lead a cross\-functional POD of Software Engineers and Software Quality Engineers. Foster a shared ownership model where quality is designed in, not bolted on, and where SQEs are equal partners in scoping, automation, and release readiness.
* People management \& culture — Line\-manage the POD: 1:1s, feedback, growth plans, hiring, and calibration. Build a fair, sustainable delivery culture that can absorb context switching and shifting priorities without burning people out or letting quality slip.


 Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
   

  

****Essential Skills \& Experience****
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don’t, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.
* Proficient with Linux, production diagnostics, and debugging / profiling tools (GDB, Address Sanitizer, perf, and similar).
* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.


****Desirable Skills \& Experience****
* Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).
* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading\-system delivery; background in kernel\-bypass / low\-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock\-free data structures.
* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.

**Compensation:**

*We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* Health \& Financial Security:
+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

* Time Off \& Flexibility:
+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.
